item.title: Mall at Wellington Green: What the 620-Apartment Nordstrom Plan Means for Wellington
item.description: Bainbridge Companies has proposed replacing the vacant Nordstrom at The Mall at Wellington Green with 620 apartments. Here is the plan, the $36 million sale, traffic and what happens next.

item.title: Winter Equestrian Festival 2027: A Local's Guide to WEF in Wellington
item.description: WEF 2027 runs January 6 to April 4 at Wellington International. Dates, when to go, spectator tips, traffic advice and where to eat during Wellington's horse show season.

item.title: Palm Beach Polo Season 2026 to 2027: A Guide to Sunday Polo in Wellington
item.description: The 2026 to 2027 Palm Beach polo season runs December 27 to May 2 at the National Polo Center in Wellington. Dates, the Gauntlet of Polo, first-timer tips and group seating.

item.title: Wellington Village (Village Landing) at K-Park: What to Expect From Wellington's First Downtown
item.description: Everything we know about Village Landing, the Wellington Village town center at K-Park on State Road 7: restaurants, shops, a Hilton hotel, the timeline, traffic plans and the fall 2028 opening.

item.title: Wingrove Academy: Everything We Know About Wellington's New Private PreK-12 School
item.description: Wingrove Academy is a new private PreK-12 school coming to Wellington's K-Park site in 2028. Here is what we know about the campus, opening date, tuition and scholarships for Wellington residents.
